title: Auxiliary Power Unit Air Intake Flap Actuator and Position Sensing Standard

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: A stiffer intake flap actuator and a repositioned proximity target on the auxiliary power unit air intake, introduced after repeated slow openings and false not-open indications on aircraft operating in dusty conditions.

sections.reason: Operators in the Gulf and in southern Africa reported flaps that took up to eleven seconds to reach the open position against a design figure of four, and a smaller number of cases where the open indication never appeared and the start was inhibited. Removed actuators were found with abrasive dust packed into the output bearing and the anti-rotation slot. Fifty-one actuator removals were recorded across the twin-engine fleet in two years, and the resulting inhibited starts pushed the auxiliary power unit availability below the dispatch figure at four operators.
sections.description: The actuator installation is reworked so that the output shaft runs in a shrouded bearing carried by the shroud D4910119498267 rather than in an exposed bush. Barrel nuts LN251117-2E and LN685489-2E are replaced with the corrosion-resistant self-locking anchor nut AGS522879K5 throughout the mounting pattern, and the plain washer LN427759-6B is added under every head to spread the load into the composite firewall panel. The proximity target that drives the open indication is moved forward onto the flap hinge arm, so that the sensed gap is taken on a machined face rather than on a painted surface that dust builds up on. Cowl latch 52PB and shroud 5135PB are refitted unchanged; the bracket 64PA is re-drilled. Access is through the auxiliary power unit compartment in zones 393 and 394, with the tail cone door open, and the outboard duct in zone 396 is disturbed.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 0.8 kg. No electrical load change; the proximity sensing installation keeps its existing supply and its existing wiring. The reworked actuator is not interchangeable with the original because the mounting pattern changes. The intake flap travel check moves from a twelve-month to a thirty-six-month interval and the abbreviated version of the check in the transit procedure is deleted. The parts catalogue figure for the intake installation gains a pre-modification and post-modification split.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN S01217. Retrofit through the associated bulletin, six manhours at any overnight stop with a tail cone access stand. The kit is a single package and the removed actuator is returned for bearing analysis.

type_data.balance_impact: Aft of the reference datum; negligible
type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN S01217 on the twin-engine line only
